title: Awaiting Customer Info ? Park + Welcome Back link ? customer returns ? back to the same agent's Assigned Cases | APPR | Controllable (Code 96 � Operations Control) | Delay 6 to under 9 hrs | 1 Pax | 1 Leg | Basic Aeroplan
description:
Checks the full park and Welcome Back cycle. Flight AC 412 YUL ? YYZ arrived 7 hours late (Code 96, Controllable). DDS returns FD-APPR-EL-02, CAD 700. In the chat, the customer said they "may have been moved to a later flight", but Trip Tracer shows no booking change. Agent Sarah Martin needs to confirm which flight was actually taken before paying out. She sends a "Welcome Back � Additional Details" request with a structured question and parks the case as Awaiting Customer Info. On Aug 8 the customer opens the deep link and goes straight to the question, without repeating earlier steps or starting a new claim. They confirm they flew AC 412 as booked. The case moves to "Update Pending Action" in Sarah's Assigned Cases list with "?? UPDATE RECEIVED". Sarah opens it (In Progress), confirms the decision and sends "Welcome Back � Payout". The customer goes straight to payment. They live in Canada and pick Cash, so payment goes by Interac and only the email is collected. Opening the same link again afterwards shows the case status only.

Prerequisites:
PNR: PK002 � single passenger Olivier Bergeron (Adult, Basic Aeroplan 9876543210, good standing). AC 412 YUL ? YYZ, July 20, 2026. Scheduled arrival 12:00, actual 19:00 (7h delay). Code 96 (Operations Control � Controllable). Travelled, arrived late. Trip Tracer: no VOL/INVOL change. AC only. Claim filed Jul 28, 2026. Case reference: CASE-FD-20260728-002. No duplicate. CyberSource GREEN. Country of residence: Canada. Owner agent: Sarah Martin (Available, not On Leave). Second agent: Marc Dubois (Available). Park date: Aug 1. Customer returns: Aug 8, 11:00 (day 7, within 30 days).
